sentences.japanese: 君はもう少しで私の目を鉛筆で突き刺すところだった。
sentences.english: You nearly poked me in the eye with your pencil.

sentences.japanese: 強盗は遺留品の一つから突きとめられた。
sentences.english: The burglar was traced by one of the things he had left on the scene.

sentences.japanese: 急いだあまり私はだれか人に突き当たった。
sentences.english: In my hurry I bumped into someone.

sentences.japanese: 機が熟したら、大胆に突き進むべきだ。僕が側にいる。
sentences.english: When the time is ripe, be bold and go for it! I'll stand by you.

sentences.japanese: 岩が岸から川に突き出ていた。
sentences.english: A rock stuck out from the bank into the river.
